findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT- There was not a Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM) in the facility at the start of the inspection and there was food preparation and serving taking place. CORRECTED- A CFPM arrived during the inspection and was educated on making sure that there is always a CFPM in the facility during all hours of operation and food preparation. Ensure that there is always a CFPM on site during all hours of food preparation, cooking, and serving.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: There were no paper towels at the handwashing sink at the start of the inspection. CORRECTED- The employee replaced the paper towels. Ensure that there is always a supply of individual, disposable towels at all handwashing sinks to allow for the proper use of a barrier during the handwashing process.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: There are no Chlorine test strips available to test the concentration of the Chlorine sanitizer in the dish machine. A follow up is scheduled for 2/5/2026 to ensure that Chlorine test strips have been obtained. There should always be test strips for every type of sanitizer that is being used in a facility to ensure that food-contact surfaces are being sanitized at a label-recommended concentration.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: The faucet of the triple sink in the kitchen is observed to have a dripping leak coming from it. Ensure that this leak is repaired. All plumbing systems should be maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(B) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The top of the inside of the ice machine was observed to have slight soil residue accumulation. CORRECTED- The top of the inside of the ice machine was cleaned during the inspection. Ensure that food contact surfaces are clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment:
REPEAT- There is not a temperature measuring device observed in the following coolers: 

1. The Grab and Go Drink Cooler.
2. The Grab and Go Cooler containing Uncrustables and other food items. 
3. The yogurt cooler in the buffet area. 

Ensure that every cold and hot holding unit has a temperature measuring device located in either the warmest part of a refrigerated unit or in the coolest part of a hot holding unit.
findings.citation_text: 4-204.112(A) Temperature Measuring Devices. (A) In a mechanically refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, the sensor of a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure the air temperature or a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of a mechanically refrigerated unit and in the coolest part of a hot FOOD storage unit.

findings.title: Food properly labeled; original container.
findings.comment: The bulk dispensers of cereal and the clear display case containing breads, muffins, bagels, etc. are both observed to not have proper allergen labeling. The facility has placed the Notice to Consumer Allergen poster in both areas, but this is not sufficient. There needs to be either a placard, labels, a poster, or some other method that clearly indicates the allergens that are in each item for consumers to be able to easily view. Bulk food that is available for consumer self-dispensing needs to have allergen labeling posted for consumers.
findings.citation_text: 3-602.11(C) Food Labels. (C) Bulk FOOD that is available for CONSUMER self-dispensing shall be prominently labeled with the following information in plain view of the CONSUMER: (1) The manufacturer's or processor's label that was provided with the FOOD; or (2) A card, sign, or other method of notification that includes the information specified under Subparagraphs (B)(1), (2), (5) and (6) of this section.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The walk-in cooler fan cover is observed to have an accumulation of dust on it and needs to be cleaned. Ensure that physical facilities are cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. REPEAT- The soda nozzles in the buffet area have a buildup of black soil residue on them. The facility stated in the past that the syrup causes this buildup. It is recommended to reach out to Coke to see if there is a way to fix this issue or it is recommended to scrub them daily to avoid this build up. Clear soda nozzles are also a recommended option to be able to easily see this build up to clean it. CORRECTED- These soda nozzles were cleaned during the inspection. Ensure that food contact surfaces are clean to sight and touch. 

 (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
Fruit flies were observed near the drains of the buffet soda gun and in the kitchen under the utility sink. Ensure fruit flies are eliminated from the establishment. Also, multiple dead fruit flies were observed in the cabinet next to the drain of the soda gun. Ensure the cabinet is cleaned so dead fruit flies are removed. 

6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.citation_text: 3-501.17  (Pf) Observed no date mark on dairy-based half & half. Food shall be clearly marked, at the time the original container is opened in a food establishment and if the food is held for more than 24 hours, to indicate the date or day by which the food shall be consumed on the premises, sold, or discarded, when held at a temperature of 41 deg F or less for a maximum of 7 days (not exceeding a manufacturer's use-by date). Discussed applicable sections of 3-501.17 and reviewed HACCP concepts with person in charge. Food was discarded. Reference 3-501.17.

Reference 3-501.14.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment: 410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Present employee has been working in kitchen for three months and has not completed food handler training. Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.  Reference 410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430.
